subject: 165-Mile Bike Trail Through Minnesota Completed After 30 Years
posts:
Thirty years of grit connect Minnesota's wilderness through a monumental 165-mile paved cycling trail.
Evidence: 30-year build, 165 miles, 28 communities
#Infrastructure #Minnesota

A multi-decade collaborative effort successfully built one of America's longest paved bike trails along the historic Iron Range.
